# MiSTer C64 Source Notice

This directory contains a selected source allowlist copied from
`https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/C64_MiSTer.git` at commit
`62fc697e3c9b5982c9dc76aa8cd03db545d20803`.

The exact paths, license basis, exclusions, and repository-owner-directed
redistribution assumption are recorded in `import_manifest.json`. SHA-256
digests are recorded in `provenance/imports.lock.json`, and every copied file
has a row in `licenses/files.csv`.

Copyright and license notices in the imported files remain in force. Full text
copies of GPL-2.0, LGPL-3.0, and CERN-OHL-S-2.0 are in
`licenses/third_party/`. The T65 redistribution notice is included directly in
each T65 source file.

No Commodore system ROM, drive ROM, game, disk, cartridge, tape, MiSTer release
binary, generated Intel IP, logo, or manual is included or licensed by this
source import.
